Discriminator is the runbook's: static is a state, growing is a race -- and the shape reads as a slow box, not a broken one, which is why it ran 45 min before anyone asked.

31849.symptom: ssh silent for 6 min after create
31849.withdrawn: WITHDRAWN 2026-09-11, SAME DAY. Blocklisted on 'ssh silent for 6 min after create' during a burst launch of SIX boxes 4 seconds apart. All four had NO mapped 22/tcp port in the instance record when the launcher gave up, while the two that survived the same burst had real ports. Relaunched 60 s apart, three boxes sat at port=None for one 5-minute tick and ALL THREE had mapped ports and were running by the next -- so the port assignment completes, and 6 minutes is too short for a burst create rather than these hosts being bad. A wrongly blocklisted machine leaves the offer pool permanently, so the entry is withdrawn rather than left standing on a symptom that reproduced on healthy hosts.
